ValidationRule.description: To check Payment's Type and Work order when the payment status is Paid CRM-7557 - Removed EMDNumber Empty Check For NameCorrection Changes
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Service_Request', $Setup.EnableValidationRule__c.Flag_to_Prevent_editing_QAC_Paid_ServPay__c = FALSE, ISPICKVAL(Payment_Status__c,"Paid"), OR( ISBLANK(Work_Order__c), Work_Order__r.IsClosed, ISBLANK(TEXT(Payment_Type__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For Payment status to be paid, Workorder cannot be in closed status
